verdict.rationale: Mesh exposes a broad, documented API. Cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated via the API or the web app. There are also endpoints for monitoring configuration, exports, case audit trails, roles, transactions and customer lookup, and a retrievable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema covers customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources. However, API credentials are generated in the web app, and there is no evidence that risk-score equation or screening configuration can be managed via the API, so full UI parity is not shown. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API-based credential and access management, API endpoints for configuring risk-score equations and screening configurations, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
